findings.rule: Title block heat treatment field must not contradict or omit a specified heat treatment requirement.
findings.reasoning: The title block heat_treatment field is '---' (indicating none), but note N5 explicitly requires the part to be toughened to 24-32 HRC. This contradiction will likely cause the manufacturer to skip the heat treatment entirely, resulting in a part that fails functionally.
findings.correction: Update the title block heat_treatment field to reference N5 or state '24-32 HRC' so the requirement is unambiguous.

findings.rule: Functional mating surfaces on coupling parts require defined tolerances or fit classes.
findings.reasoning: Dimension D1 defines the outer cylindrical surface (F1) of this coupling spacer at ⌀66 with no tolerance. As a functional OD for a coupling, it requires a specific tolerance or fit class to ensure proper assembly and alignment; relying on the general machining tolerance of ±0.8 mm (for 30–120 range) is far too loose for a coupling interface.
findings.correction: Add an appropriate tolerance or fit class (e.g., h9, h11) to the outer diameter dimension D1.

findings.rule: Raw material stock envelope should provide adequate machining allowance relative to the finished size.
findings.reasoning: Note N10 specifies raw material as 'Ø66 BLACK ROUND BAR', while D1 specifies the finished outer diameter as exactly ⌀66. Black (hot-rolled) bar has scale, decarburization, and dimensional variation; specifying the finished size equal to the nominal stock size leaves zero machining allowance to clean up the surface, making it impossible to guarantee a round, clean, dimensionally accurate finished OD.
findings.correction: Specify a larger raw material diameter (e.g., Ø70 black round bar) or reduce the finished OD to allow sufficient stock removal for cleanup.
